facts.fact: LuxDev's project page says the programme's capacity-building component, financed by Luxembourg (EUR 46.2 million) and the European Union (EUR 6 million), supports tracking each pupil's school career in all cycles through a unique identifier, aiming at an integrated platform; the programme ran 4 May 2018 to 31 December 2025 and is shown as closed (page undated, so dated to its published month).
facts.system: Plateforme intégrée de suivi du cursus scolaire des élèves (identifiant unique)

systems.system: Plateforme intégrée de suivi du cursus scolaire des élèves (identifiant unique)
systems.country_label: plateforme intégrée de suivi du cursus scolaire des élèves, de la gestion du personnel et des statistiques scolaires
systems.owner: not stated; support is to the education ministry's management of the sector, financed by Luxembourg and the EU through LuxDev
systems.tiers: all cycles, as an aim; where it is used is not stated

note: The page states an aim (a unique identifier following each pupil through every cycle, and in time an integrated platform also covering staff and school statistics), not a system in use: no level, record-keeping or school count is given. The programme carrying it closed on 31 December 2025, inside the last twelve months; the page does not say what follows, so no last12 fact was drawn.
